description: Defines the JobPost class representing a job posting in the NurseConnect frontend project, including its properties, constructor, and a copyWith method for immutability.

classes.name: JobPost
classes.description: A data model for a nurse job posting including attributes like id, hospitalId, title, description, necessary nurses, hourly rate, hours, location coordinates, creation time, and optional distance.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the JobPost instance with an optionally updated distanceKm value.
